## 🚀 Feature Request

### 📝 Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

### 💡 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Example: I'm always frustrated when [...]

### 🎯 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 📊 Use Cases
Describe specific use cases for this feature:
1. As a [user type], I want [goal] so that [benefit]
2. ...

### 🎨 Mockups/Examples
If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples to help explain your feature.

### ⚡ Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Blocking my work
- [ ] High - Very important
- [ ] Medium - Would be nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

### 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, links, or references about the feature request here.

### 🤝 Contribution
Would you be willing to contribute to implementing this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I can work on this
- [ ] Yes, with guidance
- [ ] No, but I can help test
- [ ] No
